observations.title: Choose among conflicting crafting outputs
observations.player_action: Place ingredients matching multiple recipes and use the button above the output to choose a result.
observations.outcome: The output changes to that recipe and remains selected while the ingredients remain unchanged.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Detection must match the chosen recipe/result; identical ingredients alone cannot identify which conflicting recipe the player crafted.
